title: Numerical verification of lambda across all COMPADRE matrices
question: Do two independent algorithms (LAPACK eigendecomposition vs power iteration) agree on lambda for every valid COMPADRE v6.26.3.0 matrix?
hypothesis: Agreement within 1e-6 for >=99% of primitive matrices; disagreements only for imprimitive/reducible matrices.
method: eig vs power iteration; Validation flags
finding: Two independent numerical methods agree; imprimitive matrices need eigen-based lambda (power iteration oscillates).
